mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% per annum signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 4.0% per annum signals aggressive monetary tightening, which compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as reduced economic activity lowers corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as reduced consumer spending depresses corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% and PAYEMS declines.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) falling below 450,000 million dollars signals weakening household demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as equity markets anticipate reduced consumption-driven revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS falls below 450,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation above 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS) signals an inflationary policy response, which increases market uncertainty and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of 20-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-industrial-production regime (INDPRO > 105), a subsequent decline in INDPRO signals a supply shock, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as reduced manufacturing output pressures corporate margins and inflation expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105 and subsequently declines.
